requirements.text: The system shall provide a Registration module for citizens to file complaints and police to initiate the investigation process.
The system shall provide an Investigation module to automate tasks and improve operational efficiency post-registration.
The system shall provide a Prosecution module to record and manage court interactions.
The system shall provide a Search module for basic and advanced queries on cases, persons, crimes, modus operandi, and property.
The system shall provide a Citizen Interface module for information exchange and status acknowledgments between citizens and police.
The system shall provide a Navigation module with role-based landing pages for alerts, pending tasks, and case assignments.
The system shall provide a Configuration module to manage state-specific data, rules, acts, and sections.
The system shall provide a Support module for users to log and track defects or enhancement requests with automated alerts.
The system shall provide an Audit module to maintain an unalterable trail of all create, read, update, and delete actions on critical entities.
The system shall implement role-based access control to limit access to cases and system functionalities.
The system shall support SSL encrypted connections and HTTPS for all communications.
The system shall implement security measures including protection against SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and input validation.
The system shall support multi-tier authentication and secure VPN connections.
The system shall perform simple searches within 5-8 seconds and advanced searches within 10-15 seconds.
The system shall retrieve and display frequently accessed cases within 5-8 seconds and infrequent cases within 20 seconds.
The system shall provide context-sensitive help material accessible in both online and offline modes.
The system shall support a multilingual interface and comply with ISO 9241 standards for accessibility.
The system shall be built on a Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) to support centralized deployment and modular scaling.
The system shall support offline mode functionality for critical operations to ensure data integrity during network failures.
The system shall be compatible with standard web browsers and support mobile access via PDAs and mobile data terminals.
